evidence_scope.note: Parity and smoke suites use seeded/untrained models; historical latency and speedup fields lack reproducible hardware/run metadata.

optimizations.description: Device-resident cached Fourier frequency buffer with fused broadcast multiply, eliminating per-forward frequency rebuilds and tensor copies.
CSR GraphBatch representation and sparse message passing forward_sparse, scaling O(E) instead of dense O(N^2).
Linear-time partial selection k-NN algorithm and thread-safe immutable GraphCache avoiding redundant reconstruction on static sectors.
forward_chunked with bounded chunk size (1024-4096 rows), bounding peak VRAM during high-resolution texture generation.
Bounded channel worker per device (capacity 1024) with backpressure and 5ms dynamic batching window.

gates.finite: all model outputs, metrics, and residuals strictly finite
gates.deterministic: all cached, sparse, and chunked inference operations reproduce identically across repeated evaluations
gates.parity: Fourier cache bitwise identical (diff == 0.0); GNN sparse vs dense diff < 1e-4; SIREN chunked bitwise identical
gates.accuracy_gate: not evaluated on trained checkpoints; synthetic/untrained sweeps are not a model-quality gate

exit_gate.performance_improved: not_verified: historical speedup values lack hardware identity and raw benchmark output
exit_gate.accuracy_calibration: not_verified: parity tests do not evaluate trained checkpoint accuracy
exit_gate.peak_memory_bounded: implementation paths exist, but no reproducible peak-memory report is attached
